problem: Evaluate the double integral ${∬}_{R}\frac{1}{x}\operatorname{cos}⁡y\,\text{d}A$ over the rectangle $R=[1,e]\times [0,\frac{\pi }{2}].$

feedback.problem: Which of the following gives the value of the double integral ${∬}_{R}\sqrt{xy}\text{ }\frac{1}{y}\,\text{d}A$ over the rectangle $R=[0,5]\times [3,7]?$
feedback.worked_solution:
We apply the multiplicative property of double integrals, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{R}\sqrt{xy}\text{ }\frac{1}{y}\,\text{d}A & ={∬}_{R}{x}^{1/2}\,{y}^{1/2}\,{y}^{-1}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{R}({x}^{1/2})\text{ }({y}^{-1/2})\,\text{d}A \\  & =({\int }_{0}^{5}\sqrt{x}\,\text{d}x)({\int }_{3}^{7}\frac{1}{\sqrt{y}}\,\text{d}y)\end{aligned}
$$
